title: GrapheneOS Workshop: Secure by Design, Private by Default
description: GrapheneOS is a private and secure mobile operating system with Android app compatibility. This 50-minute hands-on workshop will cover its design philosophy and demonstrate what using it actually feels like, from first setup to day-to-day usage. Newcomers who have never heard of GrapheneOS and long-time users are equally welcome.
